author: Daniele Morais
title: Magnitude 6.8 earthquake strikes near central Mid-Atlantic Ridge
seoTitle: Magnitude 6.8 earthquake near central Mid-Atlantic Ridge
subtitle: The quake was recorded at a depth of 10 km, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS).
excerpt: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake was recorded near central Mid-Atlantic Ridge, at a depth of 10 km, according to the USGS.
contentHtml:
A magnitude 6.8 earthquake was recorded on October 13, 2026 at 09:23 AM (Brasília time) near central Mid-Atlantic Ridge, according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). The quake occurred at a depth of roughly 10 km.

Authorities are assessing tsunami risk for the region.

What this magnitude means

Earthquakes between magnitude 6 and 7 are considered strong and are usually felt hundreds of kilometers from the epicenter.

What to expect in the coming days

After a main shock, aftershocks — smaller quakes in the same region — are expected over the following days and weeks, with frequency decreasing over time, a well-established pattern in seismology.

With data from the USGS (United States Geological Survey).
